parameters.jsCode: const request = $json || {}; const expected = 'REPLACE_WITH_EVIDENCE_GATEWAY_TOKEN'; const received = String(request.headers?.authorization || request.headers?.Authorization || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '').trim(); const tokenEquals = (left, right) => { if (!left || left.length !== right.length) return false; let diff = 0; for (let index = 0; index < left.length; index += 1) diff |= left.charCodeAt(index) ^ right.charCodeAt(index); return diff === 0; }; if (!tokenEquals(received, expected)) return [{ json: { valid: false, error: 'Unauthorized evidence gateway request.' } }]; const raw = request.body ?? request; const allowed = new Set(['operation', 'countryCode', 'table', 'maxFiles']); const errors = []; const isObject = raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw); if (!isObject) errors.push('Request body must be a JSON object.'); if (isObject && Object.keys(raw).some(key => !allowed.has(key))) errors.push('Only operation, countryCode, table, and maxFiles are accepted.'); const operation = typeof raw?.operation === 'string' ? raw.operation.trim().toLowerCase() : 'trace_table'; const countryCode = typeof raw?.countryCode === 'string' ? raw.countryCode.trim() : ''; const table = typeof raw?.table === 'string' ? raw.table.trim().toLowerCase() : ''; const maxFiles = raw?.maxFiles === undefined ? 10 : raw.maxFiles; if (operation !== 'trace_table') errors.push('Only operation=trace_table is allowed.'); if (typeof raw?.countryCode !== 'string') errors.push('countryCode must be a scalar string.'); if (typeof raw?.table !== 'string' || !/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,127}\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,127}$/.test(table)) errors.push('table must be a lowercase schema.table identifier.'); if (!Number.isInteger(maxFiles) || maxFiles < 1 || maxFiles > 20) errors.push('maxFiles must be an integer from 1 to 20.'); if (errors.length) return [{ json: { valid: false, error: errors.join(' ') } }]; return [{ json: { valid: true, operation, countryCode, table, maxFiles } }];
